rawFindings.title: `depopulate` no longer converts populated documents to ids
rawFindings.explanation: `Document#toObject()` now only returns an id when `options.convertToId` is set. Existing callers, including `save()` on new documents, still pass `{ depopulate: 1 }`, so populated reference values are serialized as full documents instead of their `_id`s.
rawFindings.suggestion: Keep honoring the depopulate path for populated child documents, e.g. restore the `options.depopulate && !options.isParent` conversion or ensure depopulate callers set `convertToId` before invoking child `toObject()`.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: For a new `Post` with `author: { type: ObjectId, ref: 'User' }` whose `author` path is populated with a `User` document before `post.save()`, the inserted document contains `author: { _id: ..., name: ... }` instead of `author: ObjectId(...)`.
